target.title: fix(ios): return promptly from noncooperative timeouts
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where iOS operations that ignored cancellation could hold `AsyncTimeout` open past its configured deadline, leaving location, permission, and gateway operations visibly stuck.

## Why This Change Was Made

The timeout race is now coordinated by an actor and unstructured child tasks, so resolving the timeout resumes the caller immediately while still cancelling the losing operation cooperatively.

## User Impact

Calls protected by `AsyncTimeout` now return their timeout error at the requested deadline even when a platform continuation does not promptly observe cancellation.

## Evidence

- Added a regression test whose operation deliberately ignores cancellation for 100 ms after the 10 ms timeout.
- `swiftc -typecheck apps/shared/OpenClawKit/Sources/OpenClawKit/AsyncTimeout.swift` passed.
- `swift test --package-path apps/shared/OpenClawKit --jobs 2 --filter AsyncTimeoutTests` is blocked by existing local macOS SwiftUI Preview macro availability in `OpenClawChatUI`, after compiling `AsyncTimeout.swift`; the failure is outside this PR's changed files.
- `git diff --check` passed.
- AI-assisted; two repository autoreview passes completed with no accepted findings.
